name: haiku-100k
description: Keeps every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step: a haiku-case agent that compacts at 100k, a /haiku-100k:setup command for main Haiku sessions, a hook that cuts oversized tool results and flags any request over 100k, the haiku-build skill (bmad-build flow on Haiku: Opus plans and reviews, Haiku builds and tests), the subagent-model-router skill (picks haiku / sonnet / opus per subagent; not registered by default), and agent-reliability (stops unproductive test/build retry loops, Opus recovery escalation; observe mode by default, /reliability, AGENT_RELIABILITY=off).

mode.title: Reliability: Mode
mode.description: observe (log only), enforce (deny), or off. Env AGENT_RELIABILITY and /reliability override it.

ruleB.title: Reliability: Rule B: block identical repeats
ruleB.description: In enforce mode, deny a repeat of a verification that failed the same way with nothing changed.

ruleA.title: Reliability: Rule A: recovery budget + Opus escalation
ruleA.description: In enforce mode, deny the next verification after maxRecoveryStrategies failed attempts and ask for the Opus recovery agent; then NEEDS_USER. Off: logged only.

maxRecoveryStrategies.title: Reliability: Recovery strategies before escalation
maxRecoveryStrategies.description: Failed reruns that followed a change (edit, mutating command) on one incident.

maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.title: Reliability: Identical failures before block
maxIdenticalFailuresBeforeBlock.description: Same action + same error + no change, this many times, then the next repeat is blocked.

failureRecordTtlMinutes.title: Reliability: Record TTL (minutes)
failureRecordTtlMinutes.description: Older failures and incidents never block.

maxRecordsPerSession.title: Reliability: Max records
maxRecordsPerSession.description: Bound on failure records kept per session.

gitTimeoutMs.title: Reliability: Git state budget (ms)
gitTimeoutMs.description: Total time for the git content token; over budget = unknown = allow.

telemetry.title: Reliability: Telemetry
telemetry.description: JSONL decisions to <telemetry folder>/<session>.jsonl (no tool output).

telemetryDir.title: Reliability: Telemetry folder
telemetryDir.description: Absolute folder for the JSONL files. Empty = telemetry/ inside this plugin's own folder.

dumpRaw.title: Reliability: Diagnostics dump
dumpRaw.description: Phase 0 only: filtered result fields to diag-<session>.jsonl. Leave off.

jevEnabled.title: Reliability: Ask JEV on near-duplicates
jevEnabled.description: Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY; errors and timeouts allow.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Reliability: JEV timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: Decision budget; on timeout the call is allowed.

jevMinConfidence.title: Reliability: JEV min confidence
jevMinConfidence.description: block_redundant_retry must reach this probability to block.

mainAgentOnly.title: Reliability: Main agent only
mainAgentOnly.description: Leave subagent verification calls alone (subagents are tracked separately when off).

extraEligible.title: Reliability: Extra eligible commands
extraEligible.description: Comma-separated command prefixes treated as tests.
